title: Paired finite-chain SSH diagnostic reliability under quenched disorder
research_question: Does a fixed two-of-three joint diagnostic using frontier splitting, edge weight, and inverse participation ratio reduce classification error relative to a frontier-gap-only diagnostic on paired finite SSH chains with chiral-symmetry-preserving off-diagonal disorder?

H1_primary.statement: The pooled joint-rule error is lower than the pooled gap-only error under off-diagonal disorder.

H2_replication.statement: The sign and H1 support decision reproduce under an independently hash-seeded namespace.
H2_replication.support_rule: replication estimand > 0 and replication H1 decision equals primary H1 decision

H3_negative_control.statement: Diagonal disorder is analyzed only as a symmetry-breaking negative control.
H3_negative_control.test: descriptive positive rates with Wilson 95% confidence intervals

model.family: finite open Su-Schrieffer-Heeger nearest-neighbor tight-binding chain

disorder_types.off_diagonal: clean hopping multiplied by exp(W*z_i), z_i uniform on [-1,1]
disorder_types.diagonal: onsite energy set to W*abs(beta)*z_i, z_i uniform on [-1,1]

randomization.purpose: pair identical random vectors across trivial and topological boundary orientations

reference_labels.diagonal_reason: onsite disorder breaks the chiral symmetry required by the preregistered random-SSH reference criterion

diagnostics.edge_vote: mean frontier-pair probability in first and last two sites >= 0.50
diagnostics.joint_prediction: at least two of gap_vote, edge_vote, and ipr_vote

analysis_plan.primary_population: all off-diagonal-disorder realization-orientation records across the frozen grid
primary_statistics: deterministic percentile-bootstrap 95% confidence interval for paired error difference
secondary_statistics: reference-label flips relative to clean parent termination
analysis_plan.multiple_testing_adjustment: not applicable because only the pooled H1 p-value is confirmatory
analysis_plan.missing_data: a failed Atlas call invalidates the run; no imputation

falsification_rules: H1 is not supported if the pooled error difference is nonpositive or the exact McNemar p-value is at least 0.05.
H2 is not supported if the replication error difference is nonpositive or its H1 support decision differs from the primary decision.
No result from diagonal disorder may be described as topological accuracy.
Observed thresholds and hypotheses will not be changed after production execution.

novelty_policy.claim: candidate methodological novelty: an auditable paired condition-level error benchmark for fixed finite-chain SSH diagnostics
novelty_policy.automated_search_limitation: absence of a direct match is not proof of novelty; external peer review remains required

reporting_requirements: model equations and all fixed thresholds
sample counts and effective W=0 handling
exact p-value and discordant McNemar counts
